paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: First axion dark matter search using a JTWPA, operated on the ADMX 'sidecar' cavity. The paper excludes axion-photon couplings above ~1e-13 GeV^-1 over 4796.7-4799.5 MHz (axion masses ~19.835-19.847 ueV, converted via m[eV]=4.136e-15*f[Hz]). No numerical table provided; the flat ~1e-13 GeV^-1 value comes from the abstract/text, with the detailed exclusion shape only in Fig. 7 (which shows frequency-dependent structure due to cavity drift, so the two-point representation is approximate). DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3 with axions constituting all of the local dark matter; Maxwell-Boltzmann line shape assumed. Confidence level not explicitly stated in the excerpt; ADMX conventionally uses 90%. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.7, 2))
